scope: Offline exact pinned-WASM replay parity and phase timing, not a new verifier verdict or cross-architecture speed claim
limitations: ABI time includes Rust advance, serialization and WASM/JS string copying; it is not pure solver time.
GC duration overlaps measured phases; do not add it to total.
Memory snapshots are not a guaranteed instantaneous peak; maxRSS is process-lifetime high-water mark.
Same-module reuse does not represent independent cold worker processes.
No API, scheduler wait, browser renderer or network time is measured.
